summary: The agent implements a solid 5-fold cross-validation pipeline with LightGBM and CatBoost, but it critically fails to compute or report any out-of-fold validation metric to assess model quality. Additionally, it ensembles the models with a naive equal-weight average, loses the original test IDs, and fails to specify categorical feature indices to the gradient boosting algorithms.
